metadata.experiment: mixed-workload A/B comparison with per-hop relay-stage diagnostics
metadata.note: Positive deltas mean higher values. For latency/completion metrics, negative deltas are generally better. Medians across small finite-flow samples are exploratory only.

config.paired_seed_policy: same seed for baseline and round-robin within each trial; condition order alternates
